_about: The phrases and thresholds behind the no-AI recce checklist and call sheet notes (src/lib/rules-preprod.js, docs/RULES-BREAKDOWN.md A2 and A4). Every recce line is something to CHECK or ASK on the visit, never a statement about the place, and is written only when a real fact in the script or the schedule triggers it. {placeholders} are filled from those facts. The same file carries the call sheet's note lines because both read the scene tags and speak the same way: a line per fact present, none invented.

recce.bestTime: {mix} scenes are planned here; look at the light at those hours.{light}
recce.bestTimeLight: Calculated for the shoot date on Day {day}: sunrise {sunrise}, sunset {sunset} (not a forecast).
recce.power: a power source for {why}: is there a socket, an owner's supply or room for a generator?
recce.parking: where {what} can stand, with the crew vehicles, and whether the road allows it.
recce.toilets: toilets for the unit{because}: are there any on site, and how far?

callsheet.lightFallback: (a default place; pin the location for exact times)
callsheet.daylightRisk: Exterior day scenes, Sc {sc}: wrap is {wrap}, after sunset ({sunset}).
callsheet.moreMoves: {n} more company move(s) on the day.
callsheet.stunts: Stunts in Sc {sc}: stunt crew and safety on set.
callsheet.child: Child artist ({names}) in Sc {sc}: a guardian on set, and the working hours are limited.
